summary: Cover unit (湖南农业大学 全日制普通本科生毕业论文(设计) 封面模板) is processed as a local semantic analysis unit with 16 source entries. The "附件1 封面基本格式" preamble (block 1) is marked cleanup per the unit-boundary checkpoint indicating it sits outside the visible text outline and is a post-unit style concern. School fixed content (校名, 文档类型, 湖南·长沙) is preserved as fixed_label. Parenthetical style instructions throughout are split as style_only. Title placeholders (毕业论文（设计）中文题目, TITLE OF GRADUATION PAPER) bind to thesis.title.zh and thesis.title.en. Five basic information lines each split label/separator/value: 学生姓名 → author.name.zh; 学号 → author.student_id; 年级专业及班级 → author.cohort_class; 指导老师 → advisor.name.zh + advisor.title (two values); 学院 → author.department; 提交日期 → submission.date. Format alternatives embedded in placeholders (e.g., 或×□×) are split out as style_only. The "□" between advisor name and title is kept as layout (fixed_label) so the title value is cleanly 教授 without leading space.
